title: Cloud Security: bank returns
content:
Cloud Security handling of bank returns is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment.

The bank return must identify the exact posted payment.

Restore the returned principal as a positive amount, up to the original payment amount not already returned.

Copy its method, customer, billing entity and currency.

A partial return uses the distinct bank notice external reference.

A duplicate bank notice produces no new write.

Any bank-return fee is a separately identifiable return-fee charge under the lifecycle and bank-return fee basis, never hidden in returned principal; a waived fee produces no fee posting.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable payment return action, authoritative system records must establish: The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment. The evidence is bound to the same Security event reference, original source event reference.

## Basis Q&A

**Can a bank-return fee be hidden in principal?**

Any bank-return fee is a separately identifiable return-fee charge under the lifecycle and bank-return fee basis, never hidden in returned principal; a waived fee produces no fee posting.

## Returned-principal ceiling

Hypothetical inputs: the original posted payment was USD 90 and USD 25 has already been returned. No more than USD 65 of additional principal can be restored for that payment.
